text.tspan: Dear School Heads, HODs, Swim Coaches, Team Managers,
Swimmers, and Parents, Future Stars Events Known
as IPSG is fully registered under Ministry of Sports
and Youth affairs through sports register ,that’s
mean future stars events are recognized and
supported by ministry ,come and join us as we
develop future stars both locally and internationally.
The Organizer reserves the right to vary the
program according to circumstances at his discretion.
For this competition, the operative date is the first
day of the meet. Any swimmer who will have his
JAN. 31. 2025 birthday on or before the first day
of the meet will swim in the 5&U-14 & Over age group.
There are no qualifying times for this meet. Swimmers must be able to
Overall trophy Team for the Best Girls and Best Boys combined. The overall
winner will be determined by the points. Medals will be awarded the top
3 finalists as gold, silver and bronze for positions 1, 2 and 3 respectively
in each event Certificates of participation will be awarded to all swimmers
who will participate in this meet All events will be swum on heat declared
Finals. Team Trophies will be collected by the Team Manager or Coach.
The entry fee is KSH 500/- for five events and Ksh.1000/- per relay per team.
There will be NO REFUND (includes deletion) of this charge if such information
is not given to the coordinator latest JAN 25. 2026 at 6.00pm. No club or
individual will be allowed to participate without clearing the entry fees.
-Cash paid to the accountant at the venue before
-CHEQUES addressed to BEFORE AND AFTER SCHOOL LTD
Team Managers and Coaches will have a virtual meeting with the Organizers
at 7.30 pm (A Google link will be shared with the teams taking part)
JAN 26.2026, and another one on Saturday JAN.31. 2026 at 8.45 am
at the poolside for a final brief.
